## PS5Save+ v0.1.0-alpha.5

This alpha improves the USB-transfer experience and consolidates diagnostics.

### Changed
- **Dashboard stays available during USB transfers.** Status, file browsing and unified logs remain readable. Configuration editing is temporarily disabled until the transfer finishes.
- **USB transfer notifications:** native PS5 notification when the destination changes and copying starts; sampled progress percentages during copying **and byte-for-byte verification**; a terminal success notification as soon as the transfer completes. Failed transfers report an error with a prompt to consult the dashboard logs.
- **Single diagnostic log:** backup engine, launcher and USB-transfer events now use `ps5save-plus/events.log`. The separate launcher-log button and unused endpoint have been removed.
- **Multiple existing backups at startup:** if more than one mounted USB contains a PS5Save+ or legacy backup location, a **one-time Debug notification** lists the detected USB mountpoints and identifies the selected drive. The exact decision is also recorded in `events.log`. Other installations remain untouched.
- Displays live USB-transfer progress on the dashboard and resets it between transfers.

### Install
Download `ps5saveplus_v0.1.0-alpha.5.elf` and launch it as usual. Existing backup data and configuration are preserved.

### Validation
Automated host tests cover USB selection, successful migration, refusal to overwrite another destination, rejection of internal paths and symlinks, and detecting multiple existing backup locations. The PS5 SDK compilation has also been checked.

**Alpha notice:** the backup migration itself was confirmed on a real PS5 in alpha.4. The new notification presentation and concurrent dashboard access must be confirmed on the console. Test with a separate copy of valuable backups. The dashboard uses TCP 8755 on a trusted local network only.

Based on [heni0xyz/PS5Save](https://github.com/heni0xyz/PS5Save). GPL-3.0.
